map_note: County boards' own data runs ahead of the state's daily dashboard; where a county's figure is higher, it is used. Butler, Clermont, Crawford, Franklin, Hamilton and Henry publish voter-level lists that include each voter's party, so their party splits are used too. Cuyahoga and Ottawa report totals only, so the extra ballots count in totals but not party shares. Butler (as of 2026-10-08 03:01): mail returned 20 (state 17); early in person 2,813 (state 1,365); ballots sent 14,521 (state 13,617). Clermont (as of 2026-10-08 03:32): mail returned 21 (state 20); early in person 1,366 (state 744). Crawford (as of 2026-10-07 15:14): early in person 286 (state 168). Cuyahoga (as of 2026-10-07 17:05): early in person 3,330 (state 1,722). Franklin (as of 2026-10-08 00:12): mail returned 164 (state 126); early in person 6,042 (state 2,898); ballots sent 70,585 (state 68,523). Hamilton (as of 2026-10-07 06:32): early in person 2,583 (state 2,356). Henry (as of 2026-10-07 15:00): early in person 297 (state 182). Ottawa (as of 2026-10-07): early in person 250 (state 239).
